adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` `save()`, after `host.save(props)` resolves, the component forces `host.category` from the client’s `categoryId` (`host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`), not from whatever `category_id` the server persisted/returned. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly substitutes `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id` is blank, so the saved record can legitimately differ from the client’s `categoryId`. This can leave `host.category` (used for display) out of sync with the actual saved `category_id`.
